requests.title: Shenzhen, Wednesday 18 Nov: the US President arrives for the APEC summit; the pool camera on the arrival ceremony, unedited.

candidates.ref: File:President Trump Participates in a Shenzhen, China Arrival Ceremony.webm

fit.why: The White House's own unedited pool record of the arrival ceremony at Shenzhen on Wednesday 18 Nov (421.8 s, one camera, no graphic seen in fifteen sampled frames): from about 45 s the President is at Air Force One's door, waves, and descends the red steps toward the welcome line by 70 s. Its own nat sound plays. The US is a party to the summit, so the shot carries RELEASED BY THE WHITE HOUSE once the party label exists (T5).

requests.title: Shenzhen, Thursday 19 Nov: the three leaders at the trilateral talks (the White House release, mute B-roll).

candidates.ref: File:President Trump, Xi and Putin Hold Trilateral Talks in China.webm

audio.reason: a produced release: mute B-roll only (bible e); the narrator speaks over it

fit.why: The White House's release of the trilateral talks on Thursday 19 Nov: Trump, Xi and Putin walking in, Xi speaking at the round table, the three at the table, Trump and Xi shaking hands. It is a produced montage (graded, cut short, a White House end card fading in from about 13.4 s), so it airs as mute B-roll only and never as a bite (bible e, sot-raw-source); the span stops at the file's own cut at 12.93 s, before the logo.

fit.why: Official White House Photo by Patrick Witty, its own caption: Trump in a pull-aside meeting with Putin during the APEC summit in Shenzhen, Thursday 19 Nov 2026. A still, for the rostrum; never under a bite from another occasion.
